options.text: RNA. More oxygen means more hydrogen bonds to water, so it is happier in water.
DNA. The missing hydroxyl was a weak spot: it could attack the backbone link next to it and cut the chain. Without it, the chain is far harder to break.
The same. One atom in a thousand cannot matter.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "One oxygen in a huge molecule."

image.alt: Two sugar rings in a strand backbone, one with a hydroxyl knob next to the link and one with a plain hydrogen there, both in warm water.
